sloka: तत् कुम्भकर्णस्य भुजप्रविद्धं शूलं शितं काञ्चनधामजुष्टम्।क्षिप्रं समुत्पत्य निगृह्य दोर्भ्यां बभञ्ज वेगेन सुतो ऽनिलस्य ।। ६.६७.६३ ।।
transliteration: tat kumbhakarṇasya bhujapraviddhaṁ śūlaṁ śitaṁ kāñcanadhāmajuṣṭam।kṣipraṁ samutpatya nigṛhya dorbhyāṁ babhañja vegena suto 'nilasya ।। 6.67.63 ।।

translations.english: Struck with mountain peaks, the Rakshasa became furious, and his pride was hurt. He opened his mouth widely making loud noises, his pike glowing like lightning, turned the pike into circles and hurled at Sugriva to put an end to him.
